use_case: Predictive maintenance model for well equipment: predicts rod pump and ESP failures up to 30 days ahead from historian and work order data, to prioritize workover rig scheduling
vendor_or_model: Company-owned gradient-boosted classification model built by a contracted data science firm on the cloud machine learning workspace
data_categories: SCADA historian data from the cloud replica (pump cards, motor current, runtime, pressures, rates); ERP work order history with technician names removed; no personal information
consequential_decision_category: None (equipment); escalates to Safety/CI if outputs ever control equipment or defer safety-critical inspections, and to Employment if used to evaluate staff
human_in_the_loop: A production engineer reviews every alert and decides whether to create a work order; the model has no write path to SCADA or the ERP
applicable_laws: No sector AI rule; FTC Act Section 5 applies only to the company's own claims about the model; contract terms with the data science firm (data use, IP, deletion); Fla. Stat. 501.171 not triggered because no personal information is used
status: Pilot (60 wells: 40 Panhandle live, 20 South Florida shadow mode); South Florida live use paused pending bias fix

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft emails, procedures, and reports
vendor_or_model: Various public chatbots today; enterprise tool with data protections under evaluation
data_categories: Risk of Restricted data (owner personal information, reservoir data, SCADA details) being pasted
risk_tier: Low (approved enterprise tool, no Restricted data); High if Restricted data were entered into a public tool
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) if owner or employee personal information is entered; trade secret protection for reservoir data
status: Public tools prohibited for Restricted and Confidential data (POL-05 4.8); approved-tools list due 2026-11-30
